title: MONSTER V3 Step 6 — Adaptive Proof Engine
scope: Read-only proof router that selects the cheapest legitimate proof obligations by change type while preserving exact-head truth. CSS/UI uses static plus targeted browser proof; router/navigation uses route contract plus fresh-session navigation; provider/data uses field contract plus provenance; release/deployment uses full merged-main plus production certification. Mixed changes compose obligations without duplicates; unknown changes fail safe to full proof.
status_semantics: Anti-Loop V2 requires changed PR task ledgers to be replay-closed as DONE. Step-6 technical acceptance is tracked independently until exact-head and merged-main proof complete.
proof_policy: Exact PR-head and merged-main proof identity is owned by live GitHub evidence and the Step-3 Truth Ledger.
